SELECT MIN(mc.note) AS production_note,
       MIN(t.title) AS movie_title,
       MIN(t.production_year) AS movie_year
FROM (
    SELECT ct.id
    FROM company_type AS ct
    WHERE ct.kind = 'production companies'
) AS ct
JOIN (
    SELECT mc.movie_id, mc.company_type_id, mc.note
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    WHERE mc.note NOT LIKE '%(as Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Pictures)%'
      AND (mc.note LIKE '%(co-production)%' OR mc.note LIKE '%(presents)%')
) AS mc ON mc.company_type_id = ct.id
JOIN (
    SELECT mi_idx.movie_id
    FROM info_type AS it
    JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON it.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
    WHERE it.info = 'top 250 rank'
) AS mi_idx ON mi_idx.movie_id = mc.movie_id
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = mc.movie_id
                AND t.id = mi_idx.movie_id
